subject: Web Development
title: WebGPU: Graphics Power Unleashed
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: WebGPU: Graphics Power Unleashed.

hook.text: WebGL brought 3D graphics to browsers, but it was built on an API from 2004.

buildup.text: WebGPU is the next generation — a modern API modeled after Vulkan and Metal.

discovery.text: It unlocks GPU compute shaders, enabling machine learning and physics simulations in browsers.

twist.text: WebGPU isn't just for graphics. Its compute pipeline rivals desktop tools for data processing.

climax.text: WebGPU makes the browser a serious platform for gaming, AI, and scientific visualization.

punchline.text: The browser gained a supercomputer's graphics card.
